audit.finding: Normal server builds a single V4LinuxServerProduct and accepts one authenticated peer; client reauth requires Rust-authenticated dead and Stop before new generation; this is not concurrent per-client accept or new path fast takeover.
Game2/4 uses per-lane local and peer FakeTCP ports plus single grouped product; currently fails PLAN028 one-server-port requirement.

Epoch identity is username+tunnelID; prepare rejects active same-lane overlap; release keyed only by epoch/lane. Must not just remove check without generation-fenced retirement and authenticated per-device takeover.
One product, owner and session. Its ConfigureTunnelMTU callback is process-TUN scoped; cannot apply independent client inner MTUs to shared server TUN.
Public CLI requires route key/tunnel ID and server validates single fixed tunnel ID; AutoLease/InstallationID request fields exist in TLS protocol but are not wired to this public CLI.

Pre-TLS ClientHello recognized marker is HMAC(routeKey, random, SNI). Account/password arrive only later under TLS. Removing route-key input without a provisioning/versioned handshake solution would break marker recognition/authentication.
Reusable 7-day memory-only install-bound lease implementation exists. Active lease protection and derived tunnel ID are available; do not duplicate.
Code is overlay over pinned original Go; new replacements/creates need exact manifest hashes and native bundle copy paths, otherwise test-only code can be mistaken for shipped product.

performance_test_sizing.note: Order-of-magnitude first-pass sizing, not observed measurement; do not conflate lane copies with delivered logical traffic.
